# Lead-Gen Content Studio

Specialized in high-converting lead-generation posts and multilingual short videos:
- Automatically adapts aspect ratios (`3:4` RedNote, `9:16` TikTok/Douyin, `16:9` YouTube/LinkedIn) and platform copy limits.
- Applies pain-point, case-study, and comparison frameworks with CTA hooks and `short-link` UTM tracking.
- Streams drafts to the mobile preview canvas for inline edits and single-image regeneration.
